description:
Expand DefaultVerifier to cover the algorithms found in real-world PKIs. Without RSA-PSS and Ed25519, the library cannot validate chains from Let's Encrypt ISRG Root X2, government PKIs, or modern CAs. Existing epic PKIX-qws tracks the 4 individual algorithms. This is the single feature addition that most expands the set of certificate chains the library can validate.

Subtasks (from PKIX-qws):
- RSA-PSS-SHA256 SignatureVerifier
- Ed25519 SignatureVerifier  
- ECDSA P-521 + SHA-512 SignatureVerifier
- Legacy SHA-1 RSA+ECDSA (feature-gated, off by default)

Acceptance: cargo test against a corpus of real-world chains from CT logs covering each algorithm.
title: Algorithm coverage: RSA-PSS, Ed25519, P-521, legacy SHA-1
